method: Editorial selection from 350 candidates; 100 playable and 20 reserves. No empirical scores claimed.

cards.title: Wrong Recipient
cards.scenario: Your goofy text went to someone you want to impress.
cards.twist: They reply with just a question mark.

cards.title: Secret Menu
cards.scenario: A restaurant lets you invent one menu item.
cards.twist: The chef will serve it to everyone at your table.

cards.title: Borrowed Jacket
cards.scenario: You spill juice on a friend's borrowed jacket.
cards.twist: They tell you it was a gift from their grandmother.

cards.title: Wrong Trophy
cards.scenario: You receive an award meant for someone else.
cards.twist: The actual winner is sitting beside you.

cards.title: Forgotten Wallet
cards.scenario: A friend forgot their wallet at lunch.
cards.twist: It's the third time this month.

cards.title: One Free Lie
cards.scenario: You may tell one harmless lie everyone will believe.
cards.twist: Your best friend will know you made it up.

cards.title: Grandparent's Gift
cards.scenario: Grandma gives you a gift you'll never use.
cards.twist: She asks to see you use it tomorrow.

cards.title: The Extra Ticket
cards.scenario: You win a ticket to an amazing event.
cards.twist: The guest gets to meet the performer; you don't.

cards.title: Wrong Name
cards.scenario: A new friend has called you the wrong name for months.
cards.twist: They introduce you to their family using that name.

cards.title: Borrowed Laugh
cards.scenario: You laugh exactly like one person for a day.
cards.twist: Every time you laugh, they hear it too.

cards.title: Proud Chef
cards.scenario: A friend proudly serves you a dish that tastes awful.
cards.twist: They're entering it in a contest tomorrow.

cards.title: The Apology Prize
cards.scenario: You accidentally break a friend's inexpensive keepsake.
cards.twist: They admit they once broke something of yours.

cards.title: Fake Laugh
cards.scenario: Someone tells a joke you don't understand.
cards.twist: They ask what your favorite part was.

cards.title: Mystery Teammate
cards.scenario: Choose a partner for a silly mystery challenge.
cards.twist: Your partner gets to choose what the challenge is.

cards.title: Costume Mix-Up
cards.scenario: You arrive in full costume. Nobody else did.
cards.twist: A photographer is taking the official party photo.

cards.title: The Honest Review
cards.scenario: A friend asks you to review their homemade game.
cards.twist: They've already submitted it to a contest.

cards.title: Karaoke Ambush
cards.scenario: Friends signed you up for karaoke.
cards.twist: The song starts, and you've never heard it before.

cards.title: Secret Talent
cards.scenario: You discover you're brilliant at one odd skill.
cards.twist: Your family enters you in a public competition.

cards.title: Nickname Spotlight
cards.scenario: You must share one fun fact about yourself.
cards.twist: Your answer becomes your nickname for the year.

cards.title: The Compliment Contest
cards.scenario: You enter a contest to give someone a compliment.
cards.twist: The winner has to hear the compliment repeated onstage.

cards.title: Robot Sidekick
cards.scenario: A tiny robot sidekick follows you for a week.
cards.twist: It announces everything it thinks, out loud.

cards.title: Movie Night
cards.scenario: You pick tonight's movie.
cards.twist: The person beside you has already seen your pick and promises to spoil the ending.

cards.title: Pocket Dragon
cards.scenario: A tiny dragon hatches in your room.
cards.twist: It sneezes sparks whenever it gets excited.

cards.title: The Big Reveal
cards.scenario: You must reveal one harmless secret about yourself.
cards.twist: Someone here already knows your secret.

cards.title: Swap Day
cards.scenario: You swap lives with someone for one day.
cards.twist: They answer all your messages and calls.

cards.title: Perfect Seat
cards.scenario: Where do you sit at the movies?
cards.twist: Your best friend insists on sitting in the exact opposite section.

cards.title: Street Makeover
cards.scenario: Overnight, you redesign your street.
cards.twist: Your neighbors vote tomorrow on whether the change stays.

cards.title: Free Lesson
cards.scenario: A celebrity offers to teach you one thing.
cards.twist: You must teach it to a stranger tomorrow.

cards.title: Time Capsule
cards.scenario: You bury one item to be opened in 20 years.
choices: A letter to your future self
cards.twist: Everyone you know will see it at opening.

cards.title: Food Forever
cards.scenario: Give up one forever.
cards.twist: The other two become free for life.

cards.title: Escape Room
cards.scenario: You're in an escape room. Pick your job.
cards.twist: Five minutes left, and the team starts arguing.

cards.title: Silent Challenge
cards.scenario: Win a prize by staying silent for an hour.
cards.twist: Your funniest friend is assigned to distract you.

cards.title: Clue Giver
cards.scenario: You're giving hints in a word-guessing game.
cards.twist: Your partner takes everything literally.

cards.title: Theme Park
cards.scenario: Skip the line for one attraction.
cards.twist: You must ride it three times.

cards.title: Tied Trophy
cards.scenario: You tie for first. There's one trophy.
cards.twist: Your friend has never won anything.

cards.title: Your Own Mascot
cards.scenario: Choose a mascot to follow you for a week.
cards.twist: It cheers every time you enter a room.

cards.title: Secret Alliance
cards.scenario: In a board game, a friend offers an alliance.
cards.twist: Your ally is secretly in the lead.

cards.title: Friends Over
cards.scenario: You're hosting friends tonight. What's the plan?
cards.twist: A new guest doesn't know anyone, and you've promised to include them.

cards.title: Blindfold Guide
cards.scenario: Your teammate is blindfolded and you guide them through a course.
choices: Ask to guide them by hand
cards.twist: The other team starts shouting fake directions.

cards.title: The Surprise Judge
cards.scenario: You're judging a contest among friends.
cards.twist: Every contestant gets to judge your next attempt.

cards.title: Lemonade War
cards.scenario: A rival opens a lemonade stand across the street.
cards.twist: They're giving away free cookies.

cards.title: Perfect Breakfast
cards.scenario: Choose a breakfast prepared perfectly.
cards.twist: You must eat the same breakfast every morning for a month.

cards.title: Spend It Fast
cards.scenario: You win $500 and must spend it within 24 hours.
cards.twist: Everyone you know will see what you bought.

cards.title: The Last Laugh
cards.scenario: Your friend challenges you not to laugh.
cards.twist: Your own embarrassing video starts playing.

cards.title: The 25th Hour
cards.scenario: You get an extra hour every day, forever.
cards.twist: Everyone else is asleep during it.

cards.title: Long Drive
cards.scenario: Six hours in a car. How do you pass the time?
cards.twist: You must keep the driver entertained.

cards.title: Named After You
cards.scenario: Something new is named after you.
cards.twist: The name includes your most embarrassing nickname.

cards.title: One-Time Replay
cards.scenario: Replay ten minutes of your day.
cards.twist: Everyone else remembers both versions.

cards.title: Double Gift
cards.scenario: You received the same gift twice.
cards.twist: Both givers will ask about it next week.

cards.title: Party Playlist
cards.scenario: You control the party music.
cards.twist: You must perform with every song.

cards.title: Raffle Win
cards.scenario: You win a raffle prize you don't want.
cards.twist: The person who donated it is right behind you.

cards.title: Secret Scorekeeper
cards.scenario: You may add one rule to game night.
cards.twist: Everyone votes on whether the rule stays for the rest of the night.

cards.title: Sibling Snoop
cards.scenario: Your sibling's private notebook is open on the table.
cards.twist: You notice your name written at the top of the page.

cards.title: Prize Wheel
cards.scenario: Choose one prize from a prize wheel.
choices: Your favorite food free for a year
cards.twist: The person on your left gets to use your prize first.

cards.title: Mom Slip
cards.scenario: You accidentally call your teacher or boss 'Mom'.
cards.twist: The whole room goes silent.

cards.title: The Neighborhood Legend
cards.scenario: A rumor says you're amazing at something.
cards.twist: Neighbors ask for a demonstration tonight.

cards.title: Kids' Table
cards.scenario: Family dinner has a kids' table and an adults' table.
cards.twist: The kids' table is getting all the games.

cards.title: Unpopular Opinion
cards.scenario: Everyone disagrees with your harmless opinion.
cards.twist: The person you most want to impress secretly agrees with you.

cards.title: Card Cheat
cards.scenario: Grandpa clearly cheats at cards.
cards.twist: The family trophy is on the line.

cards.title: The Surprise Duet
cards.scenario: Someone invites you to perform a duet.
cards.twist: They let you choose the song but insist on singing first.

cards.title: Introductions
cards.scenario: You must introduce a friend to a group.
cards.twist: They introduce you next.

cards.title: The Unexpected Day Off
cards.scenario: You wake up to a surprise day off.
cards.twist: Everyone you know also has the day off.

cards.title: Mistaken Hug
cards.scenario: Someone hugs you, mistaking you for an old friend.
cards.twist: They say they haven't seen you in years.

cards.title: The Lost Bet
cards.scenario: You lose a silly bet with friends.
cards.twist: The winner offers to do half the punishment with you.

cards.title: Mascot Dance-Off
cards.scenario: The team mascot picks you from the crowd.
cards.twist: Your section starts chanting your name.

cards.title: Mind Reading
cards.scenario: Read one person's thoughts for ten minutes.
cards.twist: They hear your thoughts too.

cards.title: Wrong Room
cards.scenario: You walk into the wrong classroom or meeting.
cards.twist: They offer you a seat.

cards.title: One Question
cards.scenario: You may ask one person any harmless question.
cards.twist: They get to ask you the same question.

cards.title: Loud Whisper
cards.scenario: You accidentally whisper a secret too loudly.
cards.twist: The person you were talking about is standing nearby.

cards.title: Magic Skill
cards.scenario: Choose a permanent ability.
cards.twist: People can ask you to use it anytime.

cards.title: Impression
cards.scenario: Friends ask you to imitate your teacher or boss.
cards.twist: That person walks in halfway through.

cards.title: The Fake Expert
cards.scenario: People mistakenly believe you're an expert.
cards.twist: They've already introduced you as tonight's instructor.

cards.title: Talking Pet
cards.scenario: Your pet can talk for one day.
choices: Ask what it thinks of you
cards.twist: It repeats everything it hears.

cards.title: Memory Replay
cards.scenario: Relive one memory perfectly.
choices: A day with someone you miss
cards.twist: Everyone who was there gets to relive it with you.

cards.title: Alien Guide
cards.scenario: A friendly alien needs a guide for one afternoon.
cards.twist: It announces everyone's honest thoughts out loud.

cards.title: The Unexpected Rematch
cards.scenario: Someone you beat at a game asks for a rematch.
cards.twist: They've been practicing for a month.

cards.title: Friendly Ghost
cards.scenario: A friendly ghost offers you a free stay in its mansion.
cards.twist: The ghost will only appear if you stay alone.

cards.title: Lucky Coin
cards.scenario: A coin guarantees success once. Use it for...
cards.twist: Everyone knows you're using it.

cards.title: Magic Pencil
cards.scenario: Whatever you draw becomes real for one hour.
cards.twist: It looks exactly as badly as you draw it.

cards.title: Wrong Winner
cards.scenario: You receive the prize meant for another contestant.
cards.twist: The real winner is your biggest rival.

cards.title: Honest Mirror
cards.scenario: Your mirror gives brutally honest outfit reviews.
cards.twist: It also shares its opinions with your family.

cards.title: Snow Day
cards.scenario: Unexpected snow day. Choose.
cards.twist: Snow melts by noon.

cards.title: Imaginary Friend
cards.scenario: Your childhood imaginary friend appears, real.
cards.twist: They remember every embarrassing thing.

cards.title: The Mystery Caller
cards.scenario: A stranger calls and insists you're their old friend.
cards.twist: They remember a story that really happened to you.

cards.title: Time Loop
cards.scenario: You repeat the same Saturday ten times.
cards.twist: One friend remembers every loop with you.

cards.title: Final Point
cards.scenario: You're one point from winning a friendly game.
cards.twist: Your youngest opponent is about to win for the first time.

cards.title: Loophole
cards.scenario: You spot a rule loophole that guarantees victory.
cards.twist: The opponent who would lose just helped you earlier.

cards.title: The Shared Jackpot
cards.scenario: You and a friend win a small prize together.
cards.twist: They insist you did all the work.

cards.title: Charades Gamble
cards.scenario: Choose your charades card.
cards.twist: It's the last turn and your team is one point behind.

cards.title: Talent Show
cards.scenario: Enter a talent contest.
cards.twist: Perform with someone you barely know.

cards.title: Buzzer Gamble
cards.scenario: You're 70% sure of the answer.
cards.twist: Wrong answers cost points.

cards.title: The Board Game Betrayal
cards.scenario: Your teammate in a board game offers a secret deal.
cards.twist: They reveal they can win without your help.

cards.title: Show-Down
cards.scenario: A tie is settled with rock-paper-scissors.
cards.twist: Your opponent tells you their move before you choose.

cards.title: Trivia Lifeline
cards.scenario: Choose a lifeline for the final quiz question.
cards.twist: Using a lifeline means splitting your prize with a stranger.

cards.title: Pie Pick
cards.scenario: You must choose who gets a harmless whipped-cream pie in the face.
cards.twist: Whoever you pick chooses the next person.

cards.title: The Final Clue
cards.scenario: You solve the last clue in a group mystery.
cards.twist: Someone else confidently announces a different answer.

cards.title: Going Viral
cards.scenario: A silly video of you unexpectedly goes viral.
cards.twist: It shows a moment you wish nobody had seen.

cards.title: Comeback Plan
cards.scenario: Your team is losing badly.
cards.twist: Opponents offer you one rule change.

cards.title: Generous Friend
cards.scenario: A friend offers to buy you an expensive treat.
cards.twist: You suspect they're spending money they need.

cards.title: The Friendly Roast
cards.scenario: Friends invite you to a playful, good-natured roast.
choices: Tell a compliment disguised as a joke
cards.twist: The person you tease gets the final comeback.

reserves.title: Birthday Dessert
reserves.scenario: Pick your birthday dessert.
reserves.twist: You must make it yourself with no recipe.

reserves.title: Water Park
reserves.scenario: Have one attraction to yourself.
reserves.twist: You have only ten minutes.

reserves.title: Secret Keeper
reserves.scenario: A friend shares a harmless embarrassing secret.
reserves.twist: They tell everyone tomorrow anyway.

reserves.title: Harmless Prank
reserves.scenario: Friends plan a harmless prank. Your role?
reserves.twist: The target has had a terrible day.

reserves.title: Game Night Rule
reserves.scenario: Pick a permanent game-night rule.
reserves.twist: You must follow it for a year.

reserves.title: Birthday Song
reserves.scenario: A restaurant sings Happy Birthday to you.
reserves.twist: Staff brings a silly hat you must wear.

reserves.title: Your Rule
reserves.scenario: For one day, everyone follows your rule.
reserves.twist: The rule lasts a full week.

reserves.title: Grandparent Sign
reserves.scenario: Your grandparent holds a giant sign at your event.
reserves.twist: A camera crew is filming the crowd.

reserves.title: Whispered Plans
reserves.scenario: Your friends go quiet when you walk in.
reserves.twist: Your birthday is in three days.

reserves.title: Lone Clapper
reserves.scenario: You're the only one clapping at a quiet performance.
reserves.twist: The performer is your friend.

reserves.title: Mistaken Star
reserves.scenario: Everyone thinks you're a celebrity today.
reserves.twist: A reporter asks for an interview.

reserves.title: Captain's Pick
reserves.scenario: You're captain, picking first.
reserves.twist: The other captain is your biggest rival.

reserves.title: Prank Payback
reserves.scenario: You get to prank the person on your left.
reserves.twist: They choose your payback.

reserves.title: Hot Seat
reserves.scenario: Ask someone at the table one honest question.
reserves.twist: They ask you one back.

reserves.title: Puppy Name
reserves.scenario: You must name a new puppy.
reserves.twist: You'll shout it across a crowded park.

reserves.title: Mystery Applause
reserves.scenario: A crowd suddenly applauds when you enter.
reserves.twist: Your best friend started it as a joke.

reserves.title: A Tiny Favor
reserves.scenario: A stranger asks you to help carry something.
reserves.twist: The item is a giant cardboard trophy.

reserves.title: The Costume Judge
reserves.scenario: You judge a costume contest.
reserves.twist: The winner chooses your costume next year.

reserves.title: The Accidental Coach
reserves.scenario: A team mistakes you for their new coach.
reserves.twist: They're about to play the championship.

reserves.title: The Secret Ballot
reserves.scenario: Your friends anonymously vote for the funniest person.
reserves.twist: Everyone must explain their vote afterward.

editorial_notes: Source card IDs preserved for provenance and later feedback mapping.
Some scenarios, options, and twists polished for clarity and agency.
No switch-rate threshold applied before human testing.
Review player comfort for embarrassment, privacy, and direct-table interactions.
Observe repeats and pacing in family and unfamiliar-player groups.
